info.title: EFFluentify.Cli
info.description: A .NET CLI tool that converts Entity Framework Core Data Annotations into equivalent Fluent API IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> classes, using Roslyn.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory; when omitted, generated code is written to the console

options.name: --manyFiles
options.description: Emit one configuration file per entity [default: False]

options.name: --removeAnnotationsFromMyOriginal
options.description: Remove the converted annotations from the original source files [default: False]

options.name: --namespace
options.description: The root namespace for generated files [default: EFFluentify.Configurations]
